newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges higher, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges higher, seen consolidating.

text.p: July Brent crude futures turned higher in late trading on Thursday in a mild consolidation of the recent slump in prices.
July Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.74 per barrel, up two cents from the overnight close in London.
July NYMEX crude was last traded on the after hours ACCESS system at $20.14, up two cents from its New York close.
Both Brent and NYMEX markets fell overnight, adding to a slump the day before.

But brokers said the markets were likely to consolidate the declines. News that the United Nations had endorsed a roll over of the Iraqi oil-for-food deal was factored into prices, as well as generally bearish United States stock data.
